title: Commercial Drones Outnumber Hobby Drones By 82,301
hook: Commercial drones passed hobby drones by 82,301 registrations.
closing: Drones shifted from weekend toys to working aircraft sharing the sky.
question: Would you use a work drone?

segments.say: Commercial drones lead by 82,301 registrations, showing the market now belongs more to businesses than hobbyists.
Registered drones reached 837,513, putting more unmanned aircraft into shared airspace.
Monthly drone registrations slowed to 10,500, suggesting the first gold rush is cooling.
